subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, 15% of the voters did not cast their votes and 10% of the votes polled were found invalid. The successful candidate got 55% of the valid votes and won by a majority of 6120 votes. The number of voters enrolled on the voters list was:
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Votes by which the successful candidate won the election = 6120

**CALCULATION:**

Let the initial votes be x 

15% of the voters did not cast their votes and 10% of the votes were declared invalid

Hence, Total valid votes = x × ( 85/100)
